title: cinchona mutisii var. microphylla
intro: Cinchona mutisii var. microphylla, commonly known as the small-leafed yellow cinchona, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing fever and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Cinchona mutisii var. microphylla include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating conditions like malaria and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids like quinine, quinidine, and cinchonine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
